dedupe_keys.name: tripi global transport infrastructure material stocks

description: TRIPI estimates materials embedded in roads, railways and parking infrastructure worldwide. Leiden University researchers combine OpenStreetMap geometry with infrastructure dimensions and material-intensity assumptions to describe potential urban mining stocks. The deposit reports 175 countries and subregions, with lengths, areas and material quantities aggregated nationally and regionally. The article places source extraction in February–March 2023. Zenodo supplies a main archive and continent-specific processed archives free under CC BY 4.0; several archives are multiple gigabytes. OpenStreetMap completeness and assumed dimensions are limitations for asset-level interpretation. The current companion README also mentions 176 countries, so a uniform country count is not established. Modellers could estimate replacement-material demand and recycling potential in infrastructure-stock simulations. data-openstreetmap is the source map, data-material-stock-maps-10m-buildings-infrastructure provides related stock maps, and model-odym supports stock-flow analysis. No archive was downloaded, and internal file encodings or material totals were not checked.
